CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_Attendance_ClassScheduleGuard]
ON [dbo].[Attendance]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted)
        RETURN;

    -- Gate check (51031):
    -- Caller must prehold Exclusive Transaction public locks on EC:CLASS:<id> and EC:PROGRAM:<program_id>.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                sca.class_id,
                c.program_id
            FROM (
                SELECT class_assignment_id FROM inserted
                UNION
                SELECT class_assignment_id FROM deleted
            ) a
            LEFT JOIN [dbo].[StudentClassAssignment] sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = a.class_assignment_id
            LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Class] c ON c.class_id = sca.class_id
        ) ac
        WHERE ac.class_id IS NULL
           OR ac.program_id IS NULL
           OR ISNULL(APPLOCK_MODE(N'public', N'EC:CLASS:' + CAST(ac.class_id AS nvarchar(20)), N'Transaction'), N'') <> N'Exclusive'
           OR ISNULL(APPLOCK_MODE(N'public', N'EC:PROGRAM:' + CAST(ac.program_id AS nvarchar(20)), N'Transaction'), N'') <> N'Exclusive'
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51031, 'Caller must hold exclusive transaction lock on EC:CLASS:<id> and EC:PROGRAM:<program_id>.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant check 1 (51032):
    -- Reject all mutations affecting old or new Class COMPLETED/CANCELLED.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            SELECT class_assignment_id FROM inserted
            UNION
            SELECT class_assignment_id FROM deleted
        ) a
        JOIN [dbo].[StudentClassAssignment] sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = a.class_assignment_id
        JOIN [dbo].[Class] c ON c.class_id = sca.class_id
        WHERE c.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51032, 'Cannot mutate attendance for completed or cancelled class.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant check 2 (51032):
    -- Every inserted row schedule must belong to assignment Class, is_current=1, session_type=LESSON, occurrence_state<>NOT_HELD.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted i
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[StudentClassAssignment] sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = i.class_assignment_id
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Schedule] s ON s.schedule_id = i.schedule_id
        WHERE sca.class_assignment_id IS NULL
           OR s.schedule_id IS NULL
           OR s.class_id <> sca.class_id
           OR s.is_current <> 1
           OR s.session_type <> 'LESSON'
           OR s.occurrence_state = 'NOT_HELD'
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51032, 'Schedule must belong to assignment class, be current, of session type LESSON, and occurrence state not NOT_HELD.', 1;
    END;
END;
module/dbo/trg_Band_ThresholdSetFreezeGu:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_Band_ThresholdSetFreezeGuard]
ON [dbo].[Band]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Gate check: caller must prehold Exclusive Transaction public EC:BANDSET lock.
    -- The trigger does not acquire the lock; callers must acquire it prior to DML.
    IF APPLOCK_MODE(N'public', N'EC:BANDSET', N'Transaction') IS NULL
       OR APPLOCK_MODE(N'public', N'EC:BANDSET', N'Transaction') <> N'Exclusive'
    BEGIN
        THROW 51021, N'Band threshold set modification requires preheld Exclusive Transaction lock on EC:BANDSET.', 1;
    END;

    -- If no rows were affected, exit early.
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [inserted])
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [deleted])
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Invariant check:
    -- After any completed EntryTestAttempt (score IS NOT NULL, completed_booking_id IS NOT NULL),
    -- the threshold set is frozen: reject any insert, delete, or band_code / min_score modification.
    -- First-result callers in future must acquire the same EC:BANDSET lock before DML;
    -- this trigger alone cannot prevent bypass by an unrelated direct first-result writer.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [dbo].[EntryTestAttempt]
        WHERE [score] IS NOT NULL
          AND [completed_booking_id] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        -- Check for any inserted rows (row in inserted with no matching band_id in deleted)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [inserted] [i]
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [deleted] [d]
                WHERE [d].[band_id] = [i].[band_id]
            )
        )
        -- Check for any deleted rows (row in deleted with no matching band_id in inserted)
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [deleted] [d]
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [inserted] [i]
                WHERE [i].[band_id] = [d].[band_id]
            )
        )
        -- Check for any modified band_code or min_score (compare by band_id, not UPDATE(col); exact BIN2 + DATALENGTH)
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [inserted] [i]
            INNER JOIN [deleted] [d]
                ON [d].[band_id] = [i].[band_id]
            WHERE [i].[min_score] <> [d].[min_score]
               OR [i].[band_code] COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 <> [d].[band_code] COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2
               OR DATALENGTH([i].[band_code]) <> DATALENGTH([d].[band_code])
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51022, N'Band threshold set is frozen after entry test attempts have completed.', 1;
        END;
    END;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_Component_UsedConfigurationGuard]
ON [dbo].[ScoreComponentConfig]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted)
        RETURN;

    -- Gate check: Caller must prehold Exclusive Transaction public lock on EC:PROGRAM:<id>
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            SELECT program_id FROM inserted
            UNION
            SELECT program_id FROM deleted
        ) AS affected(program_id)
        WHERE ISNULL(APPLOCK_MODE('public', N'EC:PROGRAM:' + CAST(affected.program_id AS nvarchar(30)), 'Transaction'), '') <> 'Exclusive'
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51011, 'Exclusive transaction lock EC:PROGRAM:<id> is required.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant check: Configuration of used programs (any class exists, including cancelled) cannot be modified
    IF EXISTS (
        -- Insert into used program
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted AS i
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM deleted AS d WHERE d.component_id = i.component_id
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Class] AS c WHERE c.program_id = i.program_id
        )

        UNION ALL

        -- Delete from used program
        SELECT 1
        FROM deleted AS d
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM inserted AS i WHERE i.component_id = d.component_id
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Class] AS c WHERE c.program_id = d.program_id
        )

        UNION ALL

        -- Update modifying component_name, weight, kind, or program_id where either old or new program is used
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted AS i
        INNER JOIN deleted AS d ON d.component_id = i.component_id
        WHERE (
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Class] AS c WHERE c.program_id = d.program_id)
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Class] AS c WHERE c.program_id = i.program_id)
        )
        AND (
            i.program_id <> d.program_id
            OR i.weight <> d.weight
            OR i.kind COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 <> d.kind COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2
            OR DATALENGTH(i.kind) <> DATALENGTH(d.kind)
            OR i.component_name COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 <> d.component_name COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2
            OR DATALENGTH(i.component_name) <> DATALENGTH(d.component_name)
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51012, 'Score component configuration cannot be modified for a training program with existing classes.', 1;
    END;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_Program_UsedConfigurationGuard]
ON [dbo].[TrainingProgram]
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Gate check (51001): caller must already hold Exclusive Transaction applock
    -- public EC:PROGRAM:<id> for every affected deleted/configuration-modified Program.
    -- Trigger must verify existing locks via APPLOCK_MODE and never acquire gates after DML.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM deleted d
        LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.program_id = d.program_id
        WHERE (
            APPLOCK_MODE('public', 'EC:PROGRAM:' + CAST(d.program_id AS varchar(11)), 'Transaction') IS NULL
            OR APPLOCK_MODE('public', 'EC:PROGRAM:' + CAST(d.program_id AS varchar(11)), 'Transaction') <> 'Exclusive'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51001, 'Exclusive transaction applock public EC:PROGRAM:<id> required.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant check (51002): for any deleted row whose program has ANY Class (including CANCELLED),
    -- reject deleted rows missing in inserted or changing course_id, band_id, expected_lesson_count.
    -- Allow unchanged core config including valid name/status update and value-compared no-op updates.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM deleted d
        LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.program_id = d.program_id
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [dbo].[Class] c
            WHERE c.program_id = d.program_id
        )
        AND (
            i.program_id IS NULL
            OR d.course_id <> i.course_id
            OR d.band_id <> i.band_id
            OR d.expected_lesson_count <> i.expected_lesson_count
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51002, 'Cannot delete or alter core configuration of a TrainingProgram with existing classes.', 1;
    END;
END;

        WHERE sca.class_id IS NULL
           OR c.program_id IS NULL
           OR ISNULL(APPLOCK_MODE('public', 'EC:CLASS:' + CAST(sca.class_id AS varchar(20)), 'Transaction'), '') <> 'Exclusive'
           OR ISNULL(APPLOCK_MODE('public', 'EC:PROGRAM:' + CAST(c.program_id AS varchar(20)), 'Transaction'), '') <> 'Exclusive'
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51041, 'Caller must hold Exclusive Transaction lock on EC:CLASS and EC:PROGRAM.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant (51042): Reject any mutation when old or new assignment GradeReport is SUBMITTED or FINALIZED
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            SELECT class_assignment_id FROM inserted
            UNION
            SELECT class_assignment_id FROM deleted
        ) a
        INNER JOIN dbo.GradeReport gr ON gr.class_assignment_id = a.class_assignment_id
        WHERE gr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'FINALIZED')
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51042, 'Cannot modify score when grade report is submitted or finalized.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant (51042): Inserted component must belong to assignment Class.program_id
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted i
        LEFT JOIN dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = i.class_assignment_id
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Class c ON c.class_id = sca.class_id
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ScoreComponentConfig scc ON scc.component_id = i.component_id
        WHERE scc.program_id IS NULL
           OR c.program_id IS NULL
           OR scc.program_id <> c.program_id
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51042, 'Score component does not belong to the class training program.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant (51042): GENERAL component requires NULL schedule
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted i
        INNER JOIN dbo.ScoreComponentConfig scc ON scc.component_id = i.component_id
        WHERE scc.kind = 'GENERAL'
          AND i.schedule_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51042, 'General score component must not have a schedule.', 1;
    END;

    -- Invariant (51042): LESSON and FINAL_EXAM components require a valid current same-class schedule of matching session_type and occurrence_state <> NOT_HELD
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted i
        INNER JOIN dbo.ScoreComponentConfig scc ON scc.component_id = i.component_id
        LEFT JOIN dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = i.class_assignment_id
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Schedule s ON s.schedule_id = i.schedule_id
        WHERE scc.kind IN ('LESSON', 'FINAL_EXAM')
          AND (
              i.schedule_id IS NULL
              OR s.schedule_id IS NULL
              OR sca.class_id IS NULL
              OR s.class_id <> sca.class_id
              OR s.is_current <> 1
              OR s.session_type <> scc.kind
              OR s.occurrence_state = 'NOT_HELD'
          )
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51042, 'Lesson and final exam score components require a valid current matching schedule.', 1;
    END;
END;

module/dbo/ufn_GradeTotal:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.ufn_GradeTotal
(
    @classAssignmentId int
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
        CAST(agg.requiredComponentCount AS int) AS requiredComponentCount,
        CAST(agg.enteredComponentCount AS int) AS enteredComponentCount,
        CAST(CASE
            WHEN agg.requiredComponentCount > 0 AND agg.enteredComponentCount = agg.requiredComponentCount THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS bit) AS isComplete,
        CASE
            WHEN agg.requiredComponentCount > 0 AND agg.enteredComponentCount = agg.requiredComponentCount
                THEN CAST(ROUND(agg.weightedSum / 100.0, 2) AS decimal(5,2))
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS decimal(5,2))
        END AS total
    FROM dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca
    INNER JOIN dbo.Class c ON c.class_id = sca.class_id
    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            COUNT(DISTINCT scc.component_id) AS requiredComponentCount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT s.component_id) AS enteredComponentCount,
            SUM(s.score_value * scc.weight) AS weightedSum
        FROM dbo.ScoreComponentConfig scc
        LEFT JOIN dbo.Score s ON s.class_assignment_id = sca.class_assignment_id
                             AND s.component_id = scc.component_id
        WHERE scc.program_id = c.program_id
    ) agg
    WHERE sca.class_assignment_id = @classAssignmentId
);

)

AS

(
    SELECT
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN [r].[status] IN ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') THEN 0
                WHEN EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM [dbo].[StudentClassAssignment] AS [sca]
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[Class] AS [c]
                        ON [c].[class_id] = [sca].[class_id]
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[GradeReport] AS [gr]

                    WHERE [sca].[registration_id] = [r].[registration_id]
                      AND [c].[status] = 'COMPLETED'

                ) THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END AS BIT
        ) AS [isUnfinished]
    FROM [dbo].[Registration] AS [r]
    WHERE [r].[registration_id] = @registrationId
);

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetAdmissionsReport]
    @fromUtc datetime2(3),
    @toExclusiveUtc datetime2(3),
    @courseId int = NULL,
    @status varchar(16) = NULL,
    @page int,
    @pageSize int
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 OR XACT_STATE() <> 1
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, 'An active caller transaction with SNAPSHOT isolation is required.', 1;
        END

        DECLARE @isolationLevel smallint;
        SELECT @isolationLevel = transaction_isolation_level
        FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
        WHERE session_id = @@SPID;

        IF @isolationLevel IS NULL OR @isolationLevel <> 5
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, 'An active caller transaction with SNAPSHOT isolation is required.', 1;
        END

        IF @fromUtc IS NULL
           OR @toExclusiveUtc IS NULL
           OR @fromUtc >= @toExclusiveUtc
           OR @page IS NULL
           OR @page < 1
           OR @pageSize IS NULL
           OR @pageSize < 1
           OR @pageSize > 100
           OR (@courseId IS NOT NULL AND @courseId < 1)
           OR (@status IS NOT NULL AND (@status COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT IN ('PENDING', 'TESTING', 'BAND_ASSIGNED', 'CONFIRMED', 'ADMITTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') OR DATALENGTH(@status) <> LEN(@status)))
        BEGIN
            THROW 51103, 'Invalid filter or pagination parameters.', 1;
        END

        DECLARE @offset bigint = (CONVERT(bigint, @page) - 1) * CONVERT(bigint, @pageSize);

        DECLARE @Cohort TABLE (
            registration_id int NOT NULL,
            student_id int NOT NULL,
            course_id int NOT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO @Cohort (registration_id,student_id,course_id)
        SELECT registrationId,studentId,courseId FROM dbo.vw_AdmissionsRegistrationFacts
        WHERE createdAt>=@fromUtc AND createdAt<@toExclusiveUtc
            AND (@courseId IS NULL OR courseId=@courseId)
            AND (@status IS NULL OR registrationStatus=@status);

        -- RS1: Overall cohort summary (single row)
        SELECT
            COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT ch.course_id) AS totalCount,
            COUNT_BIG(*) AS registrationCount,
            COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT ch.student_id) AS distinctStudentCount
        FROM @Cohort ch;

        -- RS2: Course groups breakdown (paginated, ordered by courseCode/courseId)
        SELECT
            c.course_id AS courseId,
            c.course_code AS courseCode,
            c.course_name AS courseName,
            COUNT_BIG(*) AS registrationCount,
            COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT ch.student_id) AS distinctStudentCount
        FROM @Cohort ch
        INNER JOIN dbo.Course c ON c.course_id = ch.course_id
        GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_name
        ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, c.course_id ASC
        OFFSET @offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY;

        -- RS3: Course options (active + referenced inactive courses)
        SELECT
            c.course_id AS courseId,
            c.course_code AS courseCode,
            c.course_name AS courseName,
            c.status AS status
        FROM dbo.Course c
        WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
           OR (
               c.status = 'INACTIVE'
               AND (
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Registration r WHERE r.course_id = c.course_id)
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TrainingProgram tp JOIN dbo.Class cl ON cl.program_id=tp.program_id WHERE tp.course_id = c.course_id)
               )
           )
        ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, c.course_id ASC;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
module/dbo/usp_GetClassGradeReview:
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.usp_GetClassGradeReview
    @classId int,
    @actorId int
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 OR XACT_STATE() <> 1
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, 'An active transaction with SNAPSHOT isolation is required.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @isolationLevel smallint;
        SELECT @isolationLevel = transaction_isolation_level
        FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
        WHERE session_id = @@SPID;

        IF @isolationLevel IS NULL OR @isolationLevel <> 5
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, 'An active transaction with SNAPSHOT isolation is required.', 1;
        END;

        IF @actorId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Account a
            INNER JOIN dbo.Role r ON r.role_id = a.role_id
            WHERE a.account_id = @actorId
              AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
              AND a.must_change_password = 0
              AND r.role_code = 'AcademicAffairs'
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51101, 'Unauthorized or restricted account.', 1;
        END;

        IF @classId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Class c
            WHERE c.class_id = @classId
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102, 'Class not found or no visible grade report.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @cohortSize int;
        DECLARE @visibleReportCount int;

        SELECT @cohortSize = COUNT(*)
        FROM dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca
        WHERE sca.class_id = @classId;

        SELECT @visibleReportCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca
        INNER JOIN dbo.GradeReport gr ON gr.class_assignment_id = sca.class_assignment_id
        WHERE sca.class_id = @classId
          AND gr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED', 'FINALIZED');

        IF @visibleReportCount = 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102, 'Class not found or no visible grade report.', 1;
        END;

        -- Result Set 1: Class Summary
        SELECT
            c.class_id AS classId,
            c.program_id AS programId,
            c.teacher_id AS teacherId,
            c.class_code AS classCode,
            c.status AS classStatus,
            CAST(c.row_version AS binary(8)) AS classVersion,
            CAST(tp.row_version AS binary(8)) AS programVersion,
            CAST(@cohortSize AS int) AS cohortSize,
            CAST(@visibleReportCount AS int) AS visibleReportCount
        FROM dbo.Class c
        INNER JOIN dbo.TrainingProgram tp ON tp.program_id = c.program_id
        WHERE c.class_id = @classId;

        -- Result Set 2: Score Component Configurations
        SELECT
            scc.component_id AS componentId,
            scc.component_name AS [name],
            scc.kind AS kind,
            scc.weight AS weight,
            CAST(scc.row_version AS binary(8)) AS [version]
        FROM dbo.ScoreComponentConfig scc
        INNER JOIN dbo.Class c ON c.program_id = scc.program_id
        WHERE c.class_id = @classId
        ORDER BY scc.component_id ASC;

        -- Result Set 3: Visible Grade Reports
        SELECT
            sca.class_assignment_id AS classAssignmentId,
            sca.registration_id AS registrationId,
            r.student_id AS studentId,
            gr.report_id AS reportId,
            a.full_name AS fullName,
            gr.status AS [status],
            gr.teacher_comment AS teacherComment,
            gr.submitted_at AS submittedAt,
            gr.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt,
            gr.finalized_at AS finalizedAt,
            gr.returned_reason AS latestReturnReason,
            gr.final_score AS finalScore,
            CAST(gr.row_version AS binary(8)) AS [version],
            fn.requiredComponentCount AS requiredComponentCount,
            fn.enteredComponentCount AS enteredComponentCount,
            fn.isComplete AS isComplete,
            fn.total AS total
        FROM dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca
        INNER JOIN dbo.GradeReport gr ON gr.class_assignment_id = sca.class_assignment_id
        INNER JOIN dbo.Registration r ON r.registration_id = sca.registration_id
        INNER JOIN dbo.StudentProfile sp ON sp.student_id = r.student_id
        INNER JOIN dbo.Account a ON a.account_id = sp.account_id
        CROSS APPLY dbo.ufn_GradeTotal(sca.class_assignment_id) fn
        WHERE sca.class_id = @classId
          AND gr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED', 'FINALIZED')
        ORDER BY sca.class_assignment_id ASC;

        -- Result Set 4: Visible Saved Scores
        SELECT
            s.class_assignment_id AS classAssignmentId,
            s.score_id AS scoreId,
            s.component_id AS componentId,
            s.score_value AS score,
            s.schedule_id AS scheduleId,
            s.entered_by AS enteredByAccountId,
            s.entered_at AS enteredAt,
            CAST(s.row_version AS binary(8)) AS [version]
        FROM dbo.Score s
        INNER JOIN dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = s.class_assignment_id
        INNER JOIN dbo.GradeReport gr ON gr.class_assignment_id = sca.class_assignment_id
        WHERE sca.class_id = @classId
          AND gr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED', 'FINALIZED')
        ORDER BY s.class_assignment_id ASC, s.component_id ASC;

        -- Result Set 5: Linked Schedule References
        SELECT DISTINCT
            sch.schedule_id AS scheduleId,
            sch.class_id AS classId,
            sch.session_type AS [type],
            sch.obligation_key AS obligationKey,
            sch.session_date AS [date],
            sch.start_time AS startTime,
            sch.end_time AS endTime,
            sch.room AS room,
            sch.occurrence_state AS occurrenceState,
            CAST(sch.is_current AS bit) AS isCurrent,
            sch.replaces_schedule_id AS replacesScheduleId,
            CAST(sch.row_version AS binary(8)) AS [version]
        FROM dbo.Schedule sch
        WHERE sch.schedule_id IN (
            SELECT s.schedule_id
            FROM dbo.Score s
            INNER JOIN dbo.StudentClassAssignment sca ON sca.class_assignment_id = s.class_assignment_id
            INNER JOIN dbo.GradeReport gr ON gr.class_assignment_id = sca.class_assignment_id
            WHERE sca.class_id = @classId
              AND gr.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED', 'FINALIZED')
              AND s.schedule_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        ORDER BY sch.schedule_id ASC;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
module/dbo/usp_GetEntryTestRoster:
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.usp_GetEntryTestRoster
    @sessionId int,
    @actorId int,
    @asOfUtc datetime2(3),
    @name nvarchar(200) = NULL,
    @email varchar(254) = NULL,
    @phone varchar(10) = NULL,
    @bookingStatus varchar(16) = NULL,
    @view varchar(8),
    @sort varchar(16),
    @page int,
    @pageSize int
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0 OR XACT_STATE() <> 1
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, N'Active caller transaction is required.', 1;
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
            WHERE session_id = @@SPID AND transaction_isolation_level = 5
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 51104, N'Snapshot transaction isolation level is required.', 1;
        END;

        IF @sessionId IS NULL
           OR @actorId IS NULL
           OR @asOfUtc IS NULL
           OR @view IS NULL
           OR @view COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT IN ('current', 'history')
           OR DATALENGTH(@view)<>LEN(@view)
           OR DATALENGTH(@sort)<>LEN(@sort)
           OR (@bookingStatus IS NOT NULL AND DATALENGTH(@bookingStatus)<>LEN(@bookingStatus))
           OR @sort IS NULL
           OR @sort COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT IN ('BOOKED_ASC', 'BOOKED_DESC')
           OR @page IS NULL
           OR @page < 1
           OR @pageSize IS NULL
           OR @pageSize < 1
           OR @pageSize > 100
           OR (@bookingStatus IS NOT NULL AND @bookingStatus COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED', 'ABSENT', 'CANCELLED'))
        BEGIN
            THROW 51103, N'Invalid entry test roster parameters.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @roleCode varchar(32);
        DECLARE @accountStatus varchar(16);
        DECLARE @mustChangePassword bit;

        SELECT
            @roleCode = r.role_code,
            @accountStatus = a.status,
            @mustChangePassword = a.must_change_password
        FROM dbo.Account a
        JOIN dbo.Role r ON r.role_id = a.role_id
        WHERE a.account_id = @actorId;

        IF @roleCode IS NULL
           OR @accountStatus <> 'ACTIVE'
           OR @mustChangePassword <> 0
           OR @roleCode NOT IN ('AcademicAffairs', 'Teacher')
        BEGIN
            THROW 51101, N'Unauthorized active role or restricted account.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @sessionGraderId int;
        DECLARE @effectiveSessionStatus varchar(16);

        SELECT
            @sessionGraderId = s.grader_id,
            @effectiveSessionStatus = dbo.ufn_EffectiveEntryTestState(s.status, s.start_at, @asOfUtc)
        FROM dbo.EntryTestSession s
        WHERE s.session_id = @sessionId;

        IF @sessionGraderId IS NULL
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102, N'Entry test session not found.', 1;
        END;

        IF @roleCode = 'Teacher' AND @sessionGraderId <> @actorId
        BEGIN
            THROW 51102, N'Entry test session not found or not assigned.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @offset bigint = (CONVERT(bigint, @page) - 1) * CONVERT(bigint, @pageSize);

        DECLARE @escapedName nvarchar(402);
        IF @name IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @escapedName = N'%' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@name, N'~', N'~~'), N'%', N'~%'), N'_', N'~_'), N'[', N'~[') + N'%';
        END;

        DECLARE @escapedEmail varchar(512);
        IF @email IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @escapedEmail = '%' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@email, '~', '~~'), '%', '~%'), '_', '~_'), '[', '~[') + '%';
        END;

        DECLARE @escapedPhone varchar(30);
        IF @phone IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @escapedPhone = '%' + REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@phone, '~', '~~'), '%', '~%'), '_', '~_'), '[', '~[') + '%';
        END;

        -- Result Set 1: Total Count
        SELECT CAST(COUNT_BIG(*) AS bigint) AS totalCount
        FROM dbo.vw_EntryTestBookingFacts v
        WHERE v.sessionId = @sessionId
          AND (@view = 'history' OR v.bookingStatus = 'SCHEDULED')
          AND (@bookingStatus IS NULL OR v.bookingStatus = @bookingStatus)
          AND (@escapedName IS NULL OR v.fullName LIKE @escapedName ESCAPE '~')
          AND (@escapedEmail IS NULL OR v.email LIKE @escapedEmail ESCAPE '~')
          AND (@escapedPhone IS NULL OR v.phone LIKE @escapedPhone ESCAPE '~');

        -- Result Set 2: Paged Roster Rows
        IF @roleCode = 'Teacher'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                v.bookingId,
                v.attemptId,
                v.registrationId,
                v.studentId,
                v.courseId,
                v.attemptNumber,
                v.bookedAt,
                v.bookingStatus,
                v.registrationStatus,
                v.fullName,
                v.email,
                v.phone,
                v.courseCode,
                v.courseName,
                v.courseStatus,
                v.targetScore,
                v.targetGradedAt,
                v.bandId,
                v.bandCode,
                v.bandMinScore
            FROM dbo.vw_EntryTestBookingFacts v
            WHERE v.sessionId = @sessionId
              AND (@view = 'history' OR v.bookingStatus = 'SCHEDULED')
              AND (@bookingStatus IS NULL OR v.bookingStatus = @bookingStatus)
              AND (@escapedName IS NULL OR v.fullName LIKE @escapedName ESCAPE '~')
              AND (@escapedEmail IS NULL OR v.email LIKE @escapedEmail ESCAPE '~')
              AND (@escapedPhone IS NULL OR v.phone LIKE @escapedPhone ESCAPE '~')
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_ASC' THEN v.bookedAt END ASC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_DESC' THEN v.bookedAt END DESC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_ASC' THEN v.bookingId END ASC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_DESC' THEN v.bookingId END DESC
            OFFSET @offset ROWS
            FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                v.bookingId,
                v.attemptId,
                v.registrationId,
                v.studentId,
                v.courseId,
                v.attemptNumber,
                v.bookedAt,
                v.bookingStatus,
                v.registrationStatus,
                v.fullName,
                v.email,
                v.phone,
                v.courseCode,
                v.courseName,
                v.courseStatus,
                v.targetScore,
                v.targetGradedAt,
                v.bandId,
                v.bandCode,
                v.bandMinScore,
                v.invoiceStatus
            FROM dbo.vw_EntryTestBookingFacts v
            WHERE v.sessionId = @sessionId
              AND (@view = 'history' OR v.bookingStatus = 'SCHEDULED')
              AND (@bookingStatus IS NULL OR v.bookingStatus = @bookingStatus)
              AND (@escapedName IS NULL OR v.fullName LIKE @escapedName ESCAPE '~')
              AND (@escapedEmail IS NULL OR v.email LIKE @escapedEmail ESCAPE '~')
              AND (@escapedPhone IS NULL OR v.phone LIKE @escapedPhone ESCAPE '~')
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_ASC' THEN v.bookedAt END ASC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_DESC' THEN v.bookedAt END DESC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_ASC' THEN v.bookingId END ASC,
                CASE WHEN @sort = 'BOOKED_DESC' THEN v.bookingId END DESC
            OFFSET @offset ROWS
            FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY;
        END;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

    @overdueOnly bit,
    @todayVn date,
    @page int = NULL,
    @pageSize int = NULL
AS
BEGIN

    BEGIN TRY
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 1
            OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
                WHERE session_id = @@SPID

            )

            OR @overdueOnly IS NULL
            OR (@courseId IS NOT NULL AND @courseId <= 0)
            OR (@page IS NULL AND @pageSize IS NOT NULL)
            OR (@page IS NOT NULL AND @pageSize IS NULL)
            OR (@page IS NOT NULL AND (@page < 1 OR @pageSize < 1 OR @pageSize > 100))
        BEGIN
            THROW 51103, 'Invalid filter, pagination, or date range parameters.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @CourseTotals TABLE
        (
            courseId int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            courseCode varchar(30) NOT NULL,
            courseName nvarchar(300) NOT NULL,
            revenueAmount decimal(38,0) NOT NULL,
            billedAmount decimal(38,0) NOT NULL,
            currentDebtAmount decimal(38,0) NOT NULL,
            overdueDebtAmount decimal(38,0) NOT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO @CourseTotals
        (
            courseId,
            courseCode,
            courseName,
            revenueAmount,
            billedAmount,
            currentDebtAmount,
            overdueDebtAmount
        )
        SELECT
            u.course_id,
            c.course_code,
            c.course_name,
            SUM(u.revenueAmount) AS revenueAmount,
            SUM(u.billedAmount) AS billedAmount,
            SUM(u.currentDebtAmount) AS currentDebtAmount,
            SUM(u.overdueDebtAmount) AS overdueDebtAmount
        FROM
        (
            SELECT v.courseId AS course_id,
                SUM(CONVERT(decimal(38,0),v.paidAmount)) AS revenueAmount,
                CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)) AS billedAmount,
                CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)) AS currentDebtAmount,
                CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)) AS overdueDebtAmount
            FROM dbo.vw_FinanceInvoiceFacts v
            WHERE v.paidAt>=@fromUtc AND v.paidAt<@toExclusiveUtc
                AND (@courseId IS NULL OR v.courseId=@courseId)
            GROUP BY v.courseId
            UNION ALL
            SELECT v.courseId,CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)),SUM(CONVERT(decimal(38,0),v.amount)),
                CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)),CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0))
            FROM dbo.vw_FinanceInvoiceFacts v
            WHERE v.invoiceStatus IN('UNPAID','PAID') AND v.issuedAt>=@fromUtc AND v.issuedAt<@toExclusiveUtc
                AND (@courseId IS NULL OR v.courseId=@courseId)
            GROUP BY v.courseId
            UNION ALL
            SELECT v.courseId,CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)),CAST(0 AS decimal(38,0)),
                SUM(CONVERT(decimal(38,0),v.amount)),
                SUM(CONVERT(decimal(38,0),CASE WHEN fn.isOverdue=1 THEN v.amount ELSE 0 END))
            FROM dbo.vw_FinanceInvoiceFacts v
            CROSS APPLY dbo.ufn_InvoiceDebtFlags(v.invoiceStatus,v.dueDate,@todayVn) fn
            WHERE v.invoiceStatus='UNPAID' AND (@overdueOnly=0 OR fn.isOverdue=1)
                AND (@courseId IS NULL OR v.courseId=@courseId)
            GROUP BY v.courseId
        ) u
        INNER JOIN dbo.Course c ON c.course_id = u.course_id
        GROUP BY u.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_name;

        -- Result Set 1: Overall Totals (exactly one row)
        SELECT
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(1) AS bigint) AS totalCount,
            COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(38), SUM(revenueAmount)), '0') AS revenueAmount,
            COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(38), SUM(billedAmount)), '0') AS billedAmount,
            COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(38), SUM(currentDebtAmount)), '0') AS currentDebtAmount,
            COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(38), SUM(overdueDebtAmount)), '0') AS overdueDebtAmount
        FROM @CourseTotals;

        -- Result Set 2: Course Groups (paged or full CSV)
        IF @page IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                courseId,
                courseCode,
                courseName,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), revenueAmount) AS revenueAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), billedAmount) AS billedAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), currentDebtAmount) AS currentDebtAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), overdueDebtAmount) AS overdueDebtAmount
            FROM @CourseTotals
            ORDER BY courseCode ASC, courseId ASC;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                courseId,
                courseCode,
                courseName,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), revenueAmount) AS revenueAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), billedAmount) AS billedAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), currentDebtAmount) AS currentDebtAmount,
                CONVERT(varchar(38), overdueDebtAmount) AS overdueDebtAmount
            FROM @CourseTotals
            ORDER BY courseCode ASC, courseId ASC
            OFFSET (CONVERT(bigint, @page) - 1) * CONVERT(bigint, @pageSize) ROWS
            FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY;
        END;

        -- Result Set 3: Course Options
        SELECT
            c.course_id AS courseId,
            c.course_code AS courseCode,
            c.course_name AS courseName,
            c.status AS status
        FROM dbo.Course c
        WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
           OR (
               c.status = 'INACTIVE'
               AND (
                   EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                       FROM dbo.Registration r
                       WHERE r.course_id = c.course_id
                   )
                   OR EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                       FROM dbo.TrainingProgram tp
                       INNER JOIN dbo.Class cl ON cl.program_id = tp.program_id
                       WHERE tp.course_id = c.course_id
                   )
               )
           )
        ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, c.course_id ASC;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
module/dbo/usp_GetTrainingReport:
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetTrainingReport]
    @courseId int = NULL,
    @bandId int = NULL,
    @classId int = NULL,
    @teacherId int = NULL,
    @status varchar(16) = NULL,
    @finalizedFromUtc datetime2(3) = NULL,
    @finalizedToExclusiveUtc datetime2(3) = NULL,
    @page int = NULL,
    @pageSize int = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF XACT_STATE() <> 1
        OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
            WHERE s.session_id = @@SPID
              AND s.transaction_isolation_level = 5
        )
    BEGIN
        THROW 51104, N'Caller transaction must be active with SNAPSHOT isolation.', 1;
    END;

    IF @finalizedFromUtc IS NULL
        OR @finalizedToExclusiveUtc IS NULL
        OR @finalizedFromUtc >= @finalizedToExclusiveUtc
        OR @page IS NULL
        OR @page < 1
        OR @pageSize IS NULL
        OR @pageSize < 1
        OR @pageSize > 100
        OR (@status IS NOT NULL AND @status COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT IN ('PLANNED', 'OPEN', 'ONGOING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
        OR (@status IS NOT NULL AND DATALENGTH(@status)<>LEN(@status))
        OR (@courseId IS NOT NULL AND @courseId < 1)
        OR (@bandId IS NOT NULL AND @bandId < 1)
        OR (@classId IS NOT NULL AND @classId < 1)
        OR (@teacherId IS NOT NULL AND @teacherId < 1)
    BEGIN
        THROW 51103, N'Invalid filters, page, or date range.', 1;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @offset bigint = (CONVERT(bigint, @page) - 1) * CONVERT(bigint, @pageSize);

        CREATE TABLE #MatchedClasses (
            classId int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            courseId int NOT NULL,
            bandId int NOT NULL,
            teacherId int NOT NULL,
            classCode varchar(30) NOT NULL,
            courseCode varchar(30) NOT NULL,
            courseName nvarchar(300) NOT NULL,
            bandCode varchar(30) NOT NULL,
            bandMinScore decimal(5,2) NOT NULL,
            classStatus varchar(16) NOT NULL,
            maxSize int NOT NULL,
            placedCount int NOT NULL,
            expectedCount int NOT NULL,
            heldCount bigint NOT NULL,
            examCurrentCount int NOT NULL,
            examHeldCount int NOT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO #MatchedClasses (
            classId,
            courseId,
            bandId,
            teacherId,
            classCode,
            courseCode,
            courseName,
            bandCode,
            bandMinScore,
            classStatus,
            maxSize,
            placedCount,
            expectedCount,
            heldCount,
            examCurrentCount,
            examHeldCount
        )
        SELECT
            f.classId,
            f.courseId,
            f.bandId,
            f.teacherId,
            f.classCode,
            f.courseCode,
            f.courseName,
            f.bandCode,
            f.bandMinScore,
            f.classStatus,
            f.maxSize,
            f.placedCount,
            f.expectedCount,
            f.heldCount,
            f.examCurrentCount,
            f.examHeldCount
        FROM dbo.vw_TrainingClassFacts AS f
        WHERE (@courseId IS NULL OR f.courseId = @courseId)
          AND (@bandId IS NULL OR f.bandId = @bandId)
          AND (@classId IS NULL OR f.classId = @classId)
          AND (@teacherId IS NULL OR f.teacherId = @teacherId)
          AND (@status IS NULL OR f.classStatus COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 = @status COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2);

        CREATE TABLE #ClassGradeAggregates (
            classId int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            finalizedResultCount bigint NOT NULL,
            passingResultCount bigint NOT NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO #ClassGradeAggregates (
            classId,
            finalizedResultCount,
            passingResultCount
        )
        SELECT
            g.classId,
            COUNT_BIG(*) AS finalizedResultCount,
            COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN g.finalScore >= 50.00 THEN 1 END) AS passingResultCount
        FROM dbo.vw_FinalizedGradeFacts AS g
        JOIN #MatchedClasses AS m ON m.classId = g.classId
        WHERE g.finalizedAt >= @finalizedFromUtc
          AND g.finalizedAt < @finalizedToExclusiveUtc
        GROUP BY g.classId;

        -- RS1: Summary metrics across full matched class set
        SELECT
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(*) AS bigint) AS totalCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(*) AS bigint) AS classCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN m.classStatus = 'PLANNED' THEN 1 END) AS bigint) AS plannedCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN m.classStatus = 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS bigint) AS openCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN m.classStatus = 'ONGOING' THEN 1 END) AS bigint) AS ongoingCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN m.classStatus = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS bigint) AS completedCount,
            CAST(COUNT_BIG(CASE WHEN m.classStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS bigint) AS cancelledCount,
            CAST(COALESCE(SUM(a.finalizedResultCount), CAST(0 AS bigint)) AS bigint) AS finalizedResultCount,
            CAST(COALESCE(SUM(a.passingResultCount), CAST(0 AS bigint)) AS bigint) AS passingResultCount,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(SUM(a.finalizedResultCount), CAST(0 AS bigint)) = 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS decimal(5,2))
                ELSE CAST(ROUND(CONVERT(decimal(28,8), SUM(a.passingResultCount)) * 100.0 / CONVERT(decimal(28,8), SUM(a.finalizedResultCount)), 2) AS decimal(5,2))
            END AS passRatePercent
        FROM #MatchedClasses AS m
        LEFT JOIN #ClassGradeAggregates AS a ON a.classId = m.classId;

        -- RS2: Paged matched-Class rows with inventory and finalized results
        SELECT
            m.classId,
            m.courseId,
            m.bandId,
            m.classCode,
            m.courseCode,
            m.courseName,
            m.bandCode,
            m.bandMinScore,
            m.classStatus,
            m.maxSize,
            m.placedCount,
            m.expectedCount,
            CASE
                WHEN m.classStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN CAST(NULL AS bigint)
                ELSE m.heldCount
            END AS heldCount,
            CASE
                WHEN m.classStatus = 'CANCELLED' OR m.expectedCount <= 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS decimal(5,2))
                ELSE CAST(ROUND(CONVERT(decimal(28,8), m.heldCount) * 100.0 / CONVERT(decimal(28,8), m.expectedCount), 2) AS decimal(5,2))
            END AS progressPercent,
            CASE
                WHEN m.classStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN CAST(NULL AS int)
                ELSE m.examCurrentCount
            END AS examCurrentCount,
            CASE
                WHEN m.classStatus = 'CANCELLED' THEN CAST(NULL AS int)
                ELSE m.examHeldCount
            END AS examHeldCount,
            CAST(COALESCE(a.finalizedResultCount, CAST(0 AS bigint)) AS bigint) AS finalizedResultCount,
            CAST(COALESCE(a.passingResultCount, CAST(0 AS bigint)) AS bigint) AS passingResultCount,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(a.finalizedResultCount, CAST(0 AS bigint)) = 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS decimal(5,2))
                ELSE CAST(ROUND(CONVERT(decimal(28,8), a.passingResultCount) * 100.0 / CONVERT(decimal(28,8), a.finalizedResultCount), 2) AS decimal(5,2))
            END AS passRatePercent
        FROM #MatchedClasses AS m
        LEFT JOIN #ClassGradeAggregates AS a ON a.classId = m.classId
        ORDER BY m.classCode ASC, m.classId ASC
        OFFSET @offset ROWS
        FETCH NEXT @pageSize ROWS ONLY;

        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ClassGradeAggregates;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MatchedClasses;

        -- RS3: Full Courses option set (Active + referenced Inactive)
        SELECT
            c.course_id AS courseId,
            c.course_code AS courseCode,
            c.course_name AS courseName,
            c.status AS status
        FROM dbo.Course AS c
        WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
           OR (
               c.status = 'INACTIVE'
               AND (
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Registration AS r WHERE r.course_id = c.course_id)
                   OR EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1
                       FROM dbo.Class AS cl
                       JOIN dbo.TrainingProgram AS tp ON tp.program_id = cl.program_id
                       WHERE tp.course_id = c.course_id
                   )
               )
           )
        ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, c.course_id ASC;

        -- RS4: Full Bands option set
        SELECT
            b.band_id AS bandId,
            b.band_code AS bandCode,
            b.min_score AS minScore
        FROM dbo.Band AS b
        ORDER BY b.band_code ASC, b.band_id ASC;

        -- RS5: Full Classes option set
        SELECT
            cl.class_id AS classId,
            tp.course_id AS courseId,
            tp.band_id AS bandId,
            cl.class_code AS classCode
        FROM dbo.Class AS cl
        JOIN dbo.TrainingProgram AS tp ON tp.program_id = cl.program_id
        ORDER BY cl.class_code ASC, cl.class_id ASC;

        -- RS6: Referenced current Class Teachers option set
        SELECT
            a.account_id AS teacherId,
            a.full_name AS displayName
        FROM dbo.Account AS a
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Class AS cl
            WHERE cl.teacher_id = a.account_id
        )
        ORDER BY a.full_name ASC, a.account_id ASC;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [dbo].[vw_TrainingClassFacts]
AS
SELECT
    c.[class_id] AS [classId],
    c.[program_id] AS [programId],
    c.[teacher_id] AS [teacherId],
    c.[class_code] AS [classCode],
    co.[course_id] AS [courseId],

    co.[status] AS [courseStatus],
    b.[band_id] AS [bandId],
    b.[band_code] AS [bandCode],
    b.[min_score] AS [bandMinScore],
    c.[status] AS [classStatus],
    c.[max_size] AS [maxSize],
    CAST(ISNULL(a.[placed_count], 0) AS int) AS [placedCount],
    p.[expectedLessonCount] AS [expectedCount],
    p.[currentLessonCount] AS [currentCount],
    p.[heldLessonCount] AS [heldCount],
    p.[currentFinalExamCount] AS [examCurrentCount],
    p.[heldFinalExamCount] AS [examHeldCount]
FROM [dbo].[Class] AS c
INNER JOIN [dbo].[TrainingProgram] AS tp
    ON tp.[program_id] = c.[program_id]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[Course] AS co
    ON co.[course_id] = tp.[course_id]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[Band] AS b
    ON b.[band_id] = tp.[band_id]
CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ClassObligationProgress](c.[class_id]) AS p
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        sca.[class_id],
        COUNT(sca.[class_assignment_id]) AS [placed_count]
    FROM [dbo].[StudentClassAssignment] AS sca
    GROUP BY sca.[class_id]
) AS a
    ON a.[class_id] = c.[class_id];
